reviewer: Final Vestige Studios editorial (research only; recordings not personally tested)

claims.claim: Zen12 is an Inspire3 meditation program
claims.fv_copy: Zen12 is an audio-based meditation program offered by Inspire3.
The seller describes twelve-minute audio sessions.

claims.claim: The full course includes 12 levels and four styles at each level (48 MP3s)
claims.fv_copy: The seller describes 12 levels and 48 MP3s in its full bundle; confirm selected tier.

claims.claim: Four styles: music, guided, white noise, nature sounds
claims.fv_copy: The seller lists guided, music, white-noise and nature-sound styles.

claims.claim: Twelve minutes provides same benefit as an hour of advanced meditation
claims.rule: Never state as fact; no adequate Zen12-specific independent evidence located.

claims.claim: Brainwave audio automatically entrains the listener's brain and does the meditating
claims.rule: 2023 review of 14 binaural-beat EEG studies: 5 positive, 8 contradictory, 1 mixed; studies heterogeneous; does not test Zen12.

claims.claim: Guaranteed immediate elimination of anxiety/stress and boosted cognition
claims.rule: No guarantee, clinical benefit or health-treatment implication in FV copy.

claims.claim: Meditation programs may help some stress-related outcomes
claims.fv_copy: A 2014 synthesis found modest benefits on some stress-related outcomes in studied meditation programs; this does not establish Zen12-specific efficacy.
claims.rule: Do not transpose other-intervention findings to Zen12.

claims.claim: Binaural-beat EEG entrainment has been proven conclusively
claims.rule: Mixed results, heterogeneous methods; avoid deterministic brainwave claim.

claims.claim: Zen12 has a one-year money-back guarantee
claims.fv_copy: The seller currently advertises a one-year money-back guarantee; verify actual contractual terms and exclusions.
claims.rule: Avoid 'risk-free' or unconditional claim before policy verified.

claims.observed_display: checkout showed $87.99 for full course after a stated promotional discount; homepage offered multiple tiers; do not assume same price via affiliate
claims.rule: Do not put merchant price in FV published copy until tracking destination verified live.

claims.claim: Free Zen12 sample requires opt-in to merchant newsletter
claims.fv_copy: The merchant's free-audio signup states subscribers also receive its newsletter.
claims.rule: Do not promise no email signup; never confuse merchant opt-in with FV Jetpack list.

claims.claim: Zen12's checkout may request phone number
claims.fv_copy: Merchant checkout requests personal contact details including a phone number; verify privacy terms before referral.
claims.rule: Never collect or proxy merchant PII within FV.

claims.claim: Affiliate marketing program provides automatic access to tracking links
claims.rule: Approval, permissions, campaign deep links, payout/attribution still unverified; no affiliate CTAs.

claims.claim: A near-link disclosure is required for material financial connection
claims.fv_copy: If you purchase through this link, Final Vestige may receive a commission.
claims.rule: One readable disclosure next to each CTA; not only in footer.
